description: This file defines a mock class 'AmbiorixMock' for testing purposes, inheriting from the 'Ambiorix' class, with mocked methods for setting and reading parameters, managing instances, and dealing with subobjects, primarily used for unit testing in the nbapi namespace.
external_methods: MOCK_METHOD (various overloaded methods for set, read_param, add_instance, remove_instance, get_instance_index, get_datamodel_time_format, remove_all_instances, add_optional_subobject, remove_optional_subobject, set_current_time, set_time)

classes.name: AmbiorixMock
classes.description: Mock version of Ambiorix class providing mocked implementations for all virtual methods, used for testing.
